text:
```yaml
name: Lint and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: 'release'

      - name: Install R packages
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("lintr", "styler", "devtools", "testthat"), repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")'

      - name: Create .lintr configuration
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' > .lintr
          lintr::lintr(
            linters = list(
              line_length_linter = lintr::line_length_linter(80),
              indentation_linter = lintr::indentation_linter(width = 2, tab = FALSE)
            )
          )
          EOF

      - name: Run lintr
        uses: r-lib/actions/lint@v1

      - name: Style code with styler
        run: Rscript -e 'styler::style_dir()'

      - name: Check package dependencies
        run: Rscript -e 'devtools::check()'

      - name: Run tests
        run: Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
```
